dedupe_keys.name: multilayer networks describing urban interactions for building the digital twins of five cities in spain

description: Multilayer networks describing urban interactions for building the digital twins of five cities in Spain is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jorge P. Rodríguez et al. Networks specifying who interacts with whom are inputs to mathematical models of epidemic spreading. In the context of emerging diseases, these networks have the potential to encode multiple interaction contexts where non-pharmaceutical interventions can be introduced, allowing for proper comparisons among different intervention strategies in different contexts. Coverage: national (ES); published in 2025. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in arXiv and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
